notes.title: v1.0.6 Update Notes!
notes.notes:
v1.0.6 Update Notes!

Dear Electronic Shop Simulator players,

The v1.0.6 update for Electronic Shop Simulator is now available! With this update, we've implemented some improvements and bug fixes to make your gaming experience even smoother.

Here's what's new:

-   **Various Bug Fixes:** Several minor bugs have been addressed to ensure a more stable gameplay experience.
-   **Easier Stand Placement:** Placing stands in your shop is now much more practical! When you move stands close to walls, they will automatically snap into alignment, and release when you move them away. This makes arranging your shop exactly as you wish much easier!

We hope these improvements enhance your Electronic Shop Simulator experience!

Sincerely,
CosarStudios

notes.title: v1.0.5 Update Notes!
notes.notes:
Dear Electronic Shop Simulator players,

The v1.0.5 update for our game is here, bringing brand new and exciting features! With this update, your shop management experience gets even richer, and there are some surprises waiting for you. We hope you enjoy playing with these new additions!

Here's what's new:

-   **Improved Inventory Management:** You can now easily move products from your sub-inventory to your main inventory. Great for a more organized stockroom!
-   **Enhanced Item Control:** Items you pick up can now be put back into your inventory by pressing the same button again. (Note: If it's the last item in your inventory that you're holding, you can't put it back.)
-   **New Characters Added: Beggar and Mafia:** Meet the new faces of the city! Sometimes, unexpected visitors might knock on your door, so be prepared!
-   **Tipping System Added:** Earn extra income by keeping your customers happy. Good service always pays off!
-   **Hunger System Added:** Running a shop takes energy! Grab some food from the stand across from your shop to satisfy your hunger, or your movement might slow down!

We hope you have a lot of fun with v1.0.5!

Sincerely,
CosarStudios

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Version 1.0.4 Update Notes:

- Automatic Cashier feature added. You can now upgrade your cashier to activate automatic payments.
- Various bugs fixed and game optimized.
- Italian language error fixed; it is now playable.

notes.title: Update Notes (v1.0.2)
notes.notes:
Update Notes (v1.0.2)
Some in-game bugs have been fixed.
Stands are now sellable. You can now sell your stands if you're not using them anymore or if you bought them by mistake.
I had changed the FPS scaling to make game performance smoother, but there was an issue with the code. The FPS scaling is incorrect. If you select 60 FPS, this will be the maximum, and if you select 100 FPS, it will be 60 FPS. This issue will be fixed in the next update.
